name: Naples, Florida (airport)
in_book: Where Matt lands in Ch. 1 and takes his driver's test in Ch. 22.

name: Alligator Alley (I-75)
in_book: The drive to the airport in Ch. 23 — 'those crazy large reptiles cheered people on.'

name: Everglades City
in_book: The mainland town; Rose lives here with her dad; Marge waits tables here.

name: Everglades City marina (Barron River)
in_book: Gas, water, and Rawley on the dock, Ch. 11.

name: Barron River
in_book: The Sea Belle's channel from Chokoloskee Bay to Everglades City.

name: Chokoloskee causeway
in_book: First view of Chokoloskee Bay, 'the glassy waters of Matt's youth.'

name: Chokoloskee Island
in_book: Home base. Seminole for 'Old House.' Dan's cottage, the grocery store, the marina.

name: Chokoloskee Bay
in_book: The bay crossed at sunrise on every trip.

name: Chokoloskee marina
in_book: Where the Mako lives, where Matt caught his first snook, where Rose waves from the last dock.

name: Dan's cottage and rookery
in_book: Stilt house with banyans out front and pelicans out back. Fictional location — place near the island's east side.

name: Anglers Motel dock
in_book: Childhood catfish and lobster traps.

name: South Point (abandoned post office)
in_book: Matt's spot. The snook, the smugglers' meeting, the sleeping-bag night. (The real Smallwood Store sits at Chokoloskee's south tip.)

name: Lopez River
in_book: First client trip, Ch. 3 — the mangrove overhang between two oyster bars.

name: Rabbit Key Pass
in_book: The way home from the storm in Ch. 3; the escape route in Ch. 10.

name: Sandfly Pass
in_book: Out to the Gulf for Comer Key camping.

name: Comer Key
in_book: Beach camping, the moccasin, the shark. Matt's first keeper redfish years ago.

name: Indian Key
in_book: Where Captain Homer hooked his tournament tarpon.

name: Pavilion Key
in_book: The seaplane drop at dawn, Ch. 9; the mangrove hideout.

name: Little Pavilion Key
in_book: Old Scarface's territory. Hooked by Russ (Ch. 7) and caught by Matt (Ch. 19).

name: Gulf of Mexico
in_book: The 'blue abyss' from the plane window.

name: Lostman's River
in_book: The destination. 'A river inside a bay inside a gulf.' The Sea Belle beached on an oyster bar near the mouth, Ch. 11–18.

name: Crooked Creek
in_book: The magazine-writer story, Ch. 15.

name: The backcountry bays
in_book: 'A navigational test for even the most experienced fishing guides.'

name: Shark River
in_book: Matt asks Snapper and Doc if they've been out there.

name: Port of the Everglades Lodge (tournament)
in_book: The tournament weigh-in. Appears fictionalized; the real Port of the Islands marina is nearby. Confirm with the author.

name: Doc's house
in_book: Rundown house down a dirt road on Chokoloskee. Fictional.

name: Key Largo flats
in_book: Snapper and President Bush's bonefish.

name: Fort Lauderdale
in_book: Matt's home. Mom's restaurant. Mr. Farmer's garage with the airboat.

name: Naples DMV
in_book: Driver's test on Matt's sixteenth birthday.
